ids.passport: Your face, your number, your block. Don't lose it.
ids.saddle: Smells of horse and old leather.
ids.magic_carpet: Hand-knotted. Flies better than it vacuums.
ids.kite: Wants the wind more than you do.
ids.skateboard: The grip tape is held on with hope.
ids.brickphone: Weighs as much as a brick. Calls like one too.
ids.vr_headset: Put it on and the market is gone.
ids.pockettv: Two channels and a lot of snow.
ids.goggles: Keeps the water out of your eyes. Mostly.
ids.headlight: Your own little sun, strapped on.
ids.kazoo: Hum into it. Feel no shame.
ids.trumpet: Loud enough to wake the block.
ids.harp: Forty-seven strings and a lot of patience.
ids.sword_ench: It hums when nobody is looking.
ids.rod_surf: For the big ones out past the pier.
ids.chest: Room for forty. The lid squeaks.
ids.orchard_key: A small iron key with a leaf on its bow.
ids.unfinished: Not done yet. Neither are you.
ids.meteor: It fell a very long way to be here.
ids.sapphire: Bluer than the river ever was.
ids.moonstone: Glows a little, if you squint.
ids.geode: Rough outside. Wait till you see in.
ids.honey_moon: It only comes on a full moon. Tastes like silver.

ids.fairticket: Good for one ride. Hold on.
